after:
Axiomotl Advisory is led by Dr Ramzi Abbassi, a laboratory digital transformation specialist with a PhD in Medicine from the University of Sydney. His SciSure author profile identifies him as a Principal Analyst at the University of Queensland.

His work focuses on scientific productivity and data management in biotech and life sciences. He emphasises transparency and consistent standards in research data, alongside security. His writing covers digital research operations and electronic lab notebooks, including the importance of change management and ongoing training and support.

At Axiomotl, he draws on this experience to help teams use evidence to make decisions, establish governance and prepare for operational handover.
